Explanation: The core value unit is a short e-scooter or e-bike trip using a vehicle that Lime has made available in the city.
Lime owns and operates the platform, designs its vehicles and coordinates software, fleet operations and city relationships.
Lime has to keep enough safe vehicles available where riders need them.
More rides and better vehicle utilization improve revenue and unit economics.
Lime bears vehicle costs and must manage vandalism, maintenance, local rules and parking problems.
Lime gives riders digital access to a nearby vehicle and charges for the trip.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Unlock / Pay — Riders unlock a nearby vehicle and pay Lime for the trip. | → Consumer · Ride Access — Lime provides digital access to a charged, available e-scooter or e-bike. | ← Provider · Ready Fleet — Operations teams return charged, repaired and correctly positioned vehicles to service. | → Provider · Ops Tasks — Lime software sends charging, repair and repositioning work to operations teams. | ← Partner · Permit / Space — Cities provide the operating permission and street-space rules that make local service possible. | → Partner · Service / Data — Lime provides micromobility service and operating data that cities use to manage programs.
